library(readr)
library(dplyr)
df <- read_csv("g:\\Cryptographie\\dataframe\\movies_metadata.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(runtime = as.numeric(runtime))

shortest_runtime <- min(df$runtime, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Longest runtime:", longest_runtime, "minutes\n")
cat("Shortest runtime:", shortest_runtime, "minutes\n")

#Exercice17


library(readr)
library(dplyr)

df <- read_csv("g:\\Cryptographie\\dataframe\\movies_metadata.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(vote_count = as.numeric(vote_count))

filter_movies_by_votes <- function(data, votes) {
  filtered_movies <- data %>%
    filter(vote_count == votes) %>%
    select(title, vote_count)
  
  if (nrow(filtered_movies) > 0) {
    cat("Movies with", votes, "votes:\n")
    print(filtered_movies)
  } else {
    cat("No movies found with", votes, "votes.\n")
  }
}

specified_votes <- 500
filter_movies_by_votes(df, specified_votes)
